responsibility: Implements parsing and expansion entry points for the Rust builtin format_args-family macros. This file reparses a macro invocation’s token tree into a format string plus positional or named AST::FormatArgument values, appends newline behavior when requested, runs the format-string piece collector, builds an AST::FormatArgs node, and delegates to the format-args expander to produce the final AST::Fragment used by macro expansion.
